checks.description: Strictly authenticate a bounded, fresh, monotonic release index and a separately signed RAUC bundle; reject wrong profile, replay/downgrade, redirects outside the fixed HTTPS origin, corruption and size/time overflow.

With automatic policy enabled, stage and arm exactly one compatible update through existing RAUC transaction and idle admission; with opt-out, active print, writable/customized mode, changed state or full disk, do not mutate.
Repeated checks and injected process/power loss at fetch, publication, RAUC write, journal and arm boundaries preserve the active/fallback slots and never blindly replay an uncertain mutation.

Using a local signed feed and disposable QEMU block device, verify inactive-pair-only write, next-normal-boot activation, health confirmation and A/B fallback; stage must leave environment banks unchanged, arm may apply only the expected reviewed boot-selection delta, and shared GPT/recovery/data/MCU artifacts stay unchanged.

On the named test printer and independently reviewed deployable candidate, validate unattended inactive-slot update, next boot/health path and rollback readiness without removing eMMC or using the USB writer.
Verify fixed systemd/network configuration, truthful admin UI status, automatic-update opt-out, no automatic reboot, and repository/payload/8 GB/recovery boundaries.

constraints.text: Fail closed when trusted time is unavailable for index expiry. Persist the highest accepted channel sequence outside either OS slot so reboot, trial fallback, or rollback cannot admit an older index; exercise damaged or unavailable sequence state.

Bound the complete download, temporary publication and retained bundle within the 8 GB data budget before any slot write. Recheck opt-out and current state at staging and arming, including after a long download.

Keep the running source slot as the rollback copy. Verify the inactive boot/root write and separate arming environment delta in QEMU before physical validation. Hardware writing still requires the exact deployable candidate, target map, recovery route, owner authorization and independent high-consequence review.

decision.rationale: Commit c11f85d changes only task sequencing. The proposal, requirements and six acceptance checks are unchanged. The new QEMU task retains the previously approved qemu-ab-journey check, and physical validation now waits for it. This stays within the owner's authorization in decision 0017 and the delegated workflow in decision 0011; it does not require another owner decision. Completing implement-offline must not be reported as completing QEMU, physical validation, or the feature. The current board image remains non-deployable, and H10 established read-only eMMC access only.
